invariants.rationale: The mergeParentElementWithTemplate method should return a non-null merged Element, barring exceptions.
The result is always produced via merging mapElement with an object subelement ("object") from a template, either from the cache or by parsing a file.
The method expects mapElement and a non-empty template attribute to function as described.
The merged result is distinct from the original mapElement, as it contains merged properties from both sources.
The merged element typically preserves the name of the parent mapElement.
